'''Sylar's hideout''' was a hiding place used by [[Sylar Saris]] on the [[planet]] [[Veelo]]. It consisted of a room built into a [[tree]] and had a hatch and tunnel leading to a [[hydroskiff]] for an escape route. The hideout was guarded by [[Water|underwater]] [[sensor]] [[mine]]s.

==History==
During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="TBBDate">{{TBBDate|308}}</ref> rogue [[Cloning|clones]] [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] teamed up with [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] to find and capture the slippery [[insectoid]]. Hunter found the hideout and engaged in combat with the wanted bounty hunter, and Wrecker joined in the fight before Saris fled through the escape tunnel.<ref name="BadTerritory" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sylar's hideout first appeared in "[[Bad Territory]],"<ref name="BadTerritory" /> the eighth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'s'' [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[March 20]], [[2024]].<ref name="Watch">{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}}</ref>
